entries.rationale: Clarify a recorded numerical reading/metric rather than the raw nonspecific nothing-has-been-recorded statement. Singular metric selection opens details/inline history from an actual statistics row; retain authored em dash and instructional action. मोजमाप is a contextual measured-statistic term choice, not external dictionary attestation.
Accept lush green appearance; French Herbe luxuriante supports appearance meaning. Same grass rules per actual terrain table/docs, not extra fertility.
Prefer direct neutral adjective dry over raw सुके; an artwork/colour variant of grass, not a claim of changed resource growth rules.
Keep head noun sand. Raw वाळूचे ढिगारे means dunes/heaps themselves and can imply raised terrain. French Sable de dune confirms dune sand; table/docs define a sand appearance sharing every sand rule.
Accept pale/light-coloured sand appearance, not low density or different movement rules.
Add natural locative relation: overlays on the map. Actual panel toggles starvation/damage/defence/fertility display overlays; retain existing आच्छादन terminology.
